findings.current: جانچ لیں کہ یہ ڈیوائس اب بھی نیٹ ورک کی رکن ہے اور دور میل کھاتا ہے؛ ہٹایا گیا ڈیوائس یا بدلا ہوا دور ہینڈ شیک مسترد کر دیتا ہے۔
findings.problem: The hint's bare 'دور میل کھاتا ہے' is ambiguous. 'دور' is the established rendering for epoch in this namespace (mesh_list.epoch = 'دور {epoch}', removed_the_membership_epoch_is_now = 'رکنیت کا موجودہ دور'), but as a standalone word it also means distance/far, so the clause can be read as 'the distance matches'. The protocol sense is recoverable only from the surrounding membership context; name the membership epoch explicitly, matching the existing 'رکنیت کا موجودہ دور'.

findings.problem: 'رکن' is masculine, so the genitive should agree with it: 'نیٹ ورک کا رکن' for an inanimate device. 'کی رکن' is the form used when the member is a female person (e.g. Cambridge's 'وہ اسکول کی ترقیاتی کمیٹی کی رکن ہے'), so here it reads the device as a person. The same pattern is pre-existing in mesh_drop.no_shared_network (out of this delta); fix both together if accepted, otherwise defer consistently.

findings.current: دوسرے سرے کا ریلے نہیں چل رہا / دوسرے سرے نے جواب دیا مگر ہینڈ شیک بند کر دیا
findings.problem: The delta renders 'peer' as 'دوسرے سرے' (the other end), while the pre-existing ui.mesh.mesh_list.answered_the_peer_read_but_is_in renders 'the peer device' as 'ہم مرتبہ ڈیوائس'. The glossary does not fix 'peer', so this is an internal-consistency choice: two terms for the same remote-device concept in one namespace. 'دوسرے سرے' is the more natural link-end wording and matches the pre-existing 'دوسرے سرے پر' for 'on the other end'; 'ہم مرتبہ' is the literal peer/equal term.
findings.suggestion: Prefer one term. If 'دوسرے سرے' is kept (recommended for these link headlines), align the pre-existing row to 'دوسرے سرے کی ڈیوائس سے ...' in the same pass or record the split as deferred; otherwise use 'ہم مرتبہ ڈیوائس' in the two headlines.

decisions_scrutinised.one_plural_arms: PASS. Urdu CLDR categories are one/other. All five new count keys carry both arms. In no_endpoint_count and not_a_member_count the one and other text is identical because the predicate is number-invariant in this telegraphic census label; ICU accepts identical arms and the one arm is present as CLDR requires. Rendered 0/1/2/3/11/21 with IntlMessageFormat: all grammatical. not_a_member_count's singular 'رکن' in the other arm is the label's predicate noun, not a counted noun; 'ارکان' would also be possible but is not required.
